text:
Maya: P0 — customer [acct: acme-corp] reporting intermittent 502/504 on hosted inference since ~2026-03-17 11:10 UTC. Error spikes in gateway pointing at cache failures: repeated \`NOAUTH Authentication required\`. Happening across multiple regions.

Sanjay: Can you paste a few gateway logs? Which model/routes impacted?

Maya: Sending snippets below:
```
[gateway] 2026-03-17T11:12:03Z WARN cache: redis prefix fetch failed: NOAUTH Authentication required
[gateway] 2026-03-17T11:12:03Z ERROR route=/v1/generate status=502 err=cache.fetch.failed
```
Most errors map to /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings. Turnaround: customers see 502->504s in UI.

Eli: That's an auth issue with Redis — did any config push or credential rotation happen to Redis cluster? InfraBot reports a credential rotation at 11:09 UTC for redis-pfx-prod.

InfraBot: system: [rotations] rotation started redis-pfx-prod by ops@kms at 2026-03-17T11:09:20Z; status=in-progress

Rachel: Pinged infra team, looking now. Quick mitigation: route gateway to bypass prefix cache and fall back to direct model path for affected tenant(s).

Maya: Customer impact: ~30% of requests fail for acme-corp, overall cluster 5xx rate +3.2%.

Sanjay: How to reproduce locally: curl to hosted API with header \`x-tenant: acme-corp\` and simulate redis noauth by toggling creds. Example:
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "x-tenant: acme-corp" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"input":"hi"}' -v
```
Logs should show NOAUTH responses.

Eli: Temp mitigation pushed: feature flag `cache_bypass=true` set for acme-corp at 11:25 UTC. Gateways will stop issuing prefix fetches and use direct model lookups.

Maya: After bypass, customer 5xx dropped to near zero for their traffic. Need root cause: why rotation didn't apply new creds to all replicas.

Rachel: Creating incident in incidents channel and opening ticket to infra: redis-pfx-prod sentinel had a slow rolling update; some nodes didn't pick up new KMS token. Escalating to infra oncall @sanjay.

Sanjay: I'll coordinate with KMS team and roll a fix. Plan: reapply creds to lagging nodes, monitor cache hit rates and 5xxs, then revert feature flag. ETA 30-45m.

Maya: Noted. Customer notified with workaround and ETA. Adding logs and diagnostic commands to ticket.

OpsBot: deployment: featureflag cache_bypass for tenant acme-corp set by eliza at 2026-03-17T11:25:12Z :white_check_mark:

Rachel: Follow-up actions: add healthcheck for redis auth failure counts to paging, add automated fallback when NOAUTH spike > threshold, and postmortem to cover rotation hardening.

Maya: Thanks. I'll keep thread updated. :thumbsup:
